parameters.name: EnsRegionIds
parameters.description: The IDs of edge nodes. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.

parameters.name: HaVipAddress
parameters.description: The IP address of the HAVIP.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the HAVIP. Valid values:

*   Creating
*   Available
*   InUse
*   Deleting
